objective: Implement the automated-run authority and lifecycle foundation so one nonhuman automation controller can operate ordinary Multiversal state only through an explicit bounded delegation grant, owning-domain operation classification and deterministic pause/resume/stop/revoke/recovery evidence, without becoming a Player/GM role, a second state engine or an authority shortcut.

APM-01.rule: Automated play is bounded orchestration of ordinary state, not a second rules/state engine or global GM authority.

APW-01.rule: Personal/Campaign/Session context and human authority remain controlling.

APW-07.rule: Recovery, idempotency, stale/conflict and hybrid safety constraints govern automated operations.

application_baseline.rule: Re-fetch current Multiversal-app main and migration directory before creating the APM-I01 branch. If either changed, re-evaluate touchpoints and any migration numbering before mutation; do not assume APM-I01 requires a new migration.

primary_touchpoints: identity/context service-actor and controller identity contracts
Action/Event command classification and operation-status/idempotency seams
feature-flag/config surfaces for bounded automated play
completion_gate: A bounded automation run has stable controller/run identity and an explicit versioned delegation grant; every candidate operation is classified as automatic_permitted, automatic_with_bounds, proposal_required, human_required or prohibited; effective authority cannot exceed current human/context/domain permission; pause/resume/stop/revoke/expiry and stale/recovery paths deterministically prevent unauthorized new operations; committed ordinary domain Events remain the only authoritative game/workspace state; and disabling automation leaves ordinary manual play available.
required_implementation_questions: Which existing identity/service-actor seam should represent automationControllerId without creating a human role or account identity?

What minimum additive record/contract represents automationRunId and AutomationDelegationGrant with exact context, controller/profile, capability, version, duration/step/event/resource and hidden-information bounds?
Which owning-domain operation classification seam can express automatic_permitted, automatic_with_bounds, proposal_required, human_required and prohibited without centralizing legality in APM?
Does APM-I01 require durable persistence on the then-current migration baseline, and if so which established owner owns run/delegation bookkeeping and what is the actual next migration number?
How are every state-affecting automated command reauthorized at execution time rather than trusting the grant, cached state, tool availability or mode flag?

What deterministic lifecycle and barriers implement draft/validating/ready/running/awaiting-human/paused/stopped/expired/revoked/stale/recovery-required/review-required/completed/failed-safe without becoming a parallel game-state ledger?
How do operation IDs, expected versions, status lookup and Event sequence evidence make retries/recovery safe while never replaying already accepted Events?
How do hidden scenario/context projections and optional-AI policy remain separate from controller authority, with a complete deterministic/no-AI/manual fallback?
Which feature-flag and rollback behavior can disable automated execution while preserving ordinary authoritative state and inspectable run/delegation evidence?
Which cross-platform acceptance cases prove authority narrowing, revocation, mandatory human barriers, stale recovery, duplicate retry safety and manual fallback?
validation_policy: Focused deterministic construction checks; exact-head application repository health; declared contract/persistence/recovery acceptance for affected surfaces; final product gate uses self-hosted Windows + self-hosted Linux + deterministic comparison where outputs should agree.
nonauthorization: Cozy loop implementation beyond authority/lifecycle foundation
next_action: Re-fetch Multiversal-app main and migration head, inspect current identity/context, permission/delegation, Action/Event, operation-status/idempotency, recovery and feature-flag seams, then create the bounded APM-I01 application branch from exact current main before implementing controller/run identity, explicit delegation, operation classification and safe run lifecycle.
